Choose the correct answer.

questions.text: 22. What effect of bicycles on the 19th-century working classes does Max want to highlight?
options: A how people spent their free time
C the way people found romantic partners

correctAnswers.22: C the way people found romantic partners

questions.text: 23. What will Max and Izzy stress about attitudes to bicycles in the 20th century?
options: A The popularity of cars reduced the status of bicycles in the 1950s.
B New designs led to an increase in sales of bicycles in the 1960s.
C An interest in fitness promoted demand for bicycles in the 1980s.

correctAnswers.23: A The popularity of cars reduced the status of bicycles in the 1950s.

questions.text: 24. What does Max say about a scheme to provide free bikes to school pupils?
options: A He wants to see more evidence of its benefits.
B He thinks it could cost the government a lot of money.
C He questions whether all parents would support it.

correctAnswers.24: A He wants to see more evidence of its benefits.
